#set $sep = ' '
denoising.py illumina @CPUS@
## PAIRED END READS #if $fastq_input.input_type == "paired" ## INPUTS #if $fastq_input.input_files.file_type == "archive" --input-archive '${fastq_input.input_files.input_archive}' #else --samples-names #for $current in $fastq_input.input_files.samples $sep'${current.samples_names.strip()}' #end for --input-R1 #for $current in $fastq_input.input_files.samples $sep'${current.input_R1}' #end for --input-R2 #for $current in $fastq_input.input_files.samples $sep'${current.input_R2}' #end for #end if
## MERGING PARAMETERS --R1-size $fastq_input.R1_size --R2-size $fastq_input.R2_size --mismatch-rate $fastq_input.mismatch_rate --merge-software $fastq_input.merge_software_type.merge_software #if $fastq_input.merge_software_type.merge_software == "flash" --expected-amplicon-size $fastq_input.merge_software_type.expected_amplicon_size #end if #if $fastq_input.keep_unmerged --keep-unmerged #end if
## SINGLE END READS #elif $fastq_input.input_type == "single" ## INPUTS #if $fastq_input.input_files.file_type == "archive" --input-archive '${fastq_input.input_files.input_archive}' #else --samples-names #for $current in $fastq_input.input_files.samples $sep'${current.samples_names.strip()}' #end for --input-R1 #for $current in $fastq_input.input_files.samples $sep'${current.input_R1}' #end for #end if #end if
## AMPLICON PARAMETERS --min-amplicon-size $min_amplicon_size --max-amplicon-size $max_amplicon_size
## PRIMERS #if $is_primer_in_seq.primer_choice == "true" --five-prim-primer '$is_primer_in_seq.five_prim_primer' --three-prim-primer '$is_primer_in_seq.three_prim_primer' #else --without-primers #end if
## PROCESS TYPE #if $process_type.process == "preprocess-only" --process preprocess-only #elif $process_type.process == "clustering" --process swarm --distance $process_type.distance $process_type.cluster_improvements.clustering_options #elif $process_type.process == "denoising" --process dada2 --sample-inference $process_type.sample_inference #end if
## OUTPUTS --output-biom $output_biom --output-fasta $output_fasta --html $html #if $process_type.process == "clustering" --output-compo $output_cluster_compo #end if

param.name: input_type
param.label: Single or Paired-end reads
param.help: Select between paired and single-end sequence data

param.name: file_type
param.label: Input type
param.help: Samples files can be provided in a single TAR archive or sample by sample (with one or two files each).

param.label: Archive file (tar format)
param.help: The TAR file containing the short R1 R2 read pairs fastq file for each sample. Illumina and Aviti sequencers are currently supported.

param.label: Name
param.help: The sample name.

param.label: R1 reads (fastq format)
param.help: R1 reads fastq file. Illumina and Aviti sequencers are currently supported.

param.label: R2 reads (fastq format)
param.help: R2 reads fastq file. Illumina and Aviti sequencers are currently supported.

param.label: Reads 1 size
param.help: The maximum read1 size.

param.label: Reads 2 size
param.help: The maximum read2 size.

param.label: Mismatch rate.
param.help: The maximum rate of mismatches in the overlap region

param.label: Merge software
param.help: Select the software to merge paired-end reads

param.label: Expected amplicon size
param.help: Maximum amplicon length expected in approximately 90% of the amplicons

param.label: Would you like to keep unmerged reads?
param.help: No = Unmerged reads will be excluded; Yes = unmerged reads will be artificially combined with 100 N.

param.name: file_type
param.label: Input type
param.help: Samples files can be provided in a single TAR archive or sample by sample (with one or two files each).

param.label: Archive file (tar format)
param.help: The TAR file containing the short single end reads or merged pair reads fastq file for each sample. Illumina and Aviti sequencers are currently supported.

param.label: Name
param.help: The sample name.

param.label: Short reads or merged reads (fastq format)
param.help: Single-end short reads or merge paired end reads fastq file. Illumina and Aviti sequencers are currently supported.

param.label: Minimum amplicon size
param.help: The minimum size of the amplicons (with primers)

param.label: Maximum amplicon size
param.help: The maximum size of the amplicons (with primers). For paired-end reads substract 10 bases corresponding to the minimum overlap between reads.

param.name: primer_choice
param.label: Do the sequences include PCR primers?
5' primer
param.help: The 5' primer sequence (wildcards are accepted). This primer must be written in 5' to 3' orientation.

param.label: 3' primer
param.help: The 3' primer sequence (wildcards are accepted). This primer must be written in 5' to 3' orientation (see details in 'Primers parameters' help section)

param.label: Process type
param.help: Select the type of process to perform

param.label: Distance threshold
param.help: The distance threshold for clustering with Swarm

param.name: clustering_options
param.label: Additionnally refine or denoise clustering
param.help: In association with --distance 1, use the Swarm --fastidious option to refine clustering (recommended since FROGS 3.2). Or use the --denoising FROGS option to perform pre-clustering with --distance = 1 before clustering with user defined distance.
param.option: Refine clusters with --fastidiouis option (recommended since FROGS 3.2)
Do not refine or denoise clustering

param.label: Dada2 pooling method
param.help: Choose how to consider sample prior to sample inferance
param.option: Pseudo pooling, samples will be pseudo-pooled prior to sample inference.
Independent, sample inference will be performed on each sample individually
Full pooling, all samples will be pooled together prior to sample inference.
